Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.service

Class RegulatoryEventService

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.service.RegulatoryEventService
All Implemented Interfaces:
MonitorRegulatoryEventsUseCase
public class RegulatoryEventService extends Object implements MonitorRegulatoryEventsUseCase
Application-layer service implementing the regulatory event monitoring use case.

Orchestrates harvest, deduplication, and persistence of regulatory events. Retrieval methods delegate directly to RegulatoryEventPort.

This class carries no Spring annotations — it is wired as a @Bean in AppConfig.
